claims.evidence: Paper Methods: three parallel SILAC-labelled HuCCT-1 cultures (control / NTRC / sgLCK) were 'lysed and pooled for proteomic analysis'; for the tyrosine phosphoproteome 'tyrosine phosphorylated peptides were enriched' (PRIDE: digest 'subjected to phosphopeptide enrichment'). One source per (culture, measured preparation): the unenriched total-proteome digest (24 HuCCT1_Global_FN* runs) and the pY-IAP eluate (HuCCT1_pY run) are different physical preparations of the same three cultures, so they get different source names but the same biological replicate.

claims.value: SILAC light = control (untreated); SILAC medium = NTRC 0652-0; SILAC heavy = doxycycline-induced LCK knockout
claims.evidence: Paper Methods (paper.txt line 158): 'parallel cultures of HuCCT-1 cells were grown in SILAC media containing light (control), medium (2H4-Lys and 13C6-Arg) (NTRC-treated) or heavy (13C615N2- Lys and 13C615N4-Arg) (sgLCK) amino acids ... treated with vehicle (control), NTRC 0652-0 1 uM for 24 hours (NTRC), or doxycycline-induction of sgLCK expression for 72 hours (sgLCK)'. MaxQuant summary.txt (both searches): Multiplicity 3, Labels0 empty, Labels1 Arg6;Lys4, Labels2 Arg10;Lys8 -> medium=Lys4/Arg6, heavy=Lys8/Arg10, matching the paper. Data check (Phospho (STY)Sites, log2 normalized): sites the paper reports hypophosphorylated in both NTRC and sgLCK vs control are down in both M/L and H/L: LCK Y192 -4.14/-1.42, LCK Y394 -3.06/-1.37, PRKCD Y313 -1.31/-1.31, EGFR Y1172 -1.42/-1.88, EPHA2 Y772 -1.59/-1.55 -> light = control. Pan-SFK autophosphorylation site LCK Y394 is lower with the SFK-inhibiting drug (M) than with LCK-only knockout (H), consistent with medium = NTRC. M/L vs H/L pY Pearson 0.742 (n=104), consistent with the paper's NTRC/sgLCK correlation (Fig 1D). Control encoded 'untreated' per template/batch rule 4 although the paper says vehicle-treated (vehicle not named).

Paper Methods: vehicle (not named -> not available), 'NTRC 0652-0 1 uM for 24 hours', 'doxycycline-induction of sgLCK expression for 72 hours'. NTRC 0652-0 has no OLS term (ols_search.txt) - free text.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: only the SILAC HuCCT-1 arm (25 raw files) is annotated. The PDX TMTpro arm (24 CCAPDX_FGFR_TMT12_Total_FN*.raw + CCAPDX_FGFR_pTyr.raw; searches PDX_Global_txt.zip / PDX_pTyr_txt.zip) is out of scope of the SILAC campaign (not missing evidence) and is recorded in BLOCKED.md as excluded runs.

Supplementary Methods and Tables (NIHMS2018255 supplement) were not retrievable (PMC reCAPTCHA bot check, not bypassed; Europe PMC: not open access). Consequently not available: fractionation method of the 24 global fractions, culture medium, passage number, vehicle identity and duration, doxycycline dose.

comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant 1.6.12.0 parameters.txt does not record the main-search precursor tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited (default would be 4.5 ppm, not asserted); convert-openms therefore fails (expected).
Whether the light (control) and medium (NTRC) cultures were parental HuCCT-1 or uninduced HuCCT-1-sgLCK cells is not stated; genetic modification = not available for them.

Single SILAC mixture: one culture per condition, no biological replication; total proteome and pTyr come from the same pooled lysate per the paper ('lysed and pooled'); that the global digest is the pre-enrichment aliquot of the same digest is implied, not stated explicitly.
Control is vehicle-treated (vehicle not named); encoded 'untreated' per batch rule 4.
